items.why: Chip stocks are tumbling broadly, with the Nasdaq sliding as chip names give back part of Monday's Nvidia-sparked rally.
Nvidia is giving back part of Monday's surge after the board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, and the Nasdaq is declining as it slides.

summary: Stocks are pulling back Tuesday morning, led by a sharp chip selloff as Nvidia gives back part of Monday's rally. The Nasdaq is down over 2% while the Dow holds nearly flat.
